definition: observe E report retains exactly those E alternatives whose report equals the actual report. It changes epistemic accessibility, not the candidate facts or report functions. note: No actual perceptual mechanism, justification, acquaintance, concept possession or reliability theorem. A small new operation reusing the existing Frame and relational Knows, since the reuse inventory found no report-based experiential update. Applicability OPEN.
